result.stdout:
Usage: ai-bridge [command]
Commands:
  init                - Scaffolds .aiignore, aiSkills/, and aiPrompts/ without overwriting existing files.
  update              - Updates aiSkills/ and aiPrompts/ to the latest defaults (overwrites existing files).
  pack                - Packs source files into text context for AI.
  apply [options]     - Applies ai-response.xml patches to the codebase.

Apply Options:
  --dry-run           - Preview changes without modifying files.
  --watch             - Keep running and auto-apply when ai-response.xml is saved.
  --paste             - Read AI response from clipboard instead of file.
